references.text: The Israelites went and did as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron - the same obedience to the Lord's command through Moses and Aaron.
The Israelites did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses - a repeated pattern of obedience to the Lord's commands.
The Israelites carried out the work exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses - the same expression of complete obedience.
The Israelites celebrated Passover just as the Lord had commanded Moses - a direct parallel to obedience in the celebration of Passover.
Moses proclaimed all that the Lord had commanded him - Moses as the messenger of the Lord's commands to the people.
Joshua did as the Lord had commanded Moses - continuation of obedience to commands given through Moses.
By faith Moses celebrated Passover and sprinkled the blood - NT reference to faithful obedience in the celebration of Passover.
A theological parallel showing that the principle of complete obedience to God's commands applies across different events and books.
A thematic parallel confirming that the principle of exact obedience applies across both ritual and practical service.
A theological parallel demonstrating continuity in obedience from the Exodus to the entry into the Promised Land.
A thematic parallel extending the principle of obedience from ritual acts to the daily walk of the entire people.
